dl.q.cost.a: Nothing extra. The app is part of your ChatHelp account – you sign in with the same email as in the Studio.
dl.q.diff: Web app or store app – what’s the difference?
dl.q.diff.a: Both show the same jobs and send notifications. The web app (Home Screen) is available instantly without a store and updates itself. The store app starts a little faster and uses the notification channels of Android or iOS directly.
dl.q.ios: Why do no notifications arrive on the iPhone?
dl.q.ios.a: Apple only allows them for web apps on the Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or later) and only if you allow them in the app. Also check: Settings → Notifications → ChatHelp → “Allow Notifications” and Focus mode.
dl.q.offline.a: The app still opens and shows the last state. Your agents keep working – as soon as the network is back, all new jobs arrive.
dl.q.team: Can several staff members use the app?
dl.q.team.a: Yes. Each device registers separately for notifications; in the app under “Alerts” you see all devices. Drivers and kitchen tablets use their own links from the Studio.
